chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from Abbas from Hakim ibn Abi al-Alla' from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him about performing Tawaf after the Asr prayer, so he said: 'Perform one Tawaf and pray two Rak'ahs before the Maghrib prayer at sunset. And if you perform another Tawaf, then pray two Rak'ahs after Maghrib.' And I asked him about performing Tawaf after Fajr, so he said: 'Perform Tawaf until the sun rises, then bow in the Rak'ahs.'
ai.seo_question: What are the recommended prayers to perform after doing Tawaf at different times of the day?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the specific timing for the two rak'ahs of Tawaf, distinguishing between the pre-Maghrib prayer for an afternoon Tawaf and the post-sunrise prayer for a morning one. It highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on adhering to precise temporal markers (ghurub al-shams and tulu' al-shams) to ensure the validity of these recommended acts, reflecting the detailed jurisprudential derivations found in al-Tusi's *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*.
